Class A Common Stock The selling stockholders named in this prospectus are offering 60,000,000 shares of our Class A common stock. Our shares of Class A common stock are listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market (“Nasdaq”) under the trading symbol “MDLN.” We and Medline Holdings (as defined herein) have agreed to repurchase an aggregate of $200 million of shares of our Class A common stock and Common Units (as defined herein) directly from the selling stockholders in a private, non-underwritten transaction at a price per equity interest of $35.05625, which is the price paid by the underwriters in this offering (the “Repurchase”). Accordingly, we expect to repurchase an aggregate of 3,788,113 shares of Class A common stock and 1,916,994 Common Units in the Repurchase. To the extent that Common Units are repurchased from a selling stockholder, upon the closing of the Repurchase, such selling stockholder will also transfer an equivalent number of shares of Class B common stock to us for no additional consideration, and such shares of Class B common stock will be cancelled and retired. The Repurchase is expected to close concurrently with the offering and is conditioned upon the closing of this offering. The closing of this of
